name: resilireplay-monorepo
description: Turn reviewed MCP failures into deterministic recovery evidence and executable regression tests.
author: Ali <268342250+aliengineering-byte@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r --sort typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.mcp-res:validate: pnpm mcp-res:validate:v0.1 && pnpm mcp-res:validate:v0.2 && pnpm mcp-res:differential && pnpm mcp-res:migration && pnpm mcp-res:attestation && pnpm mcp-res:field && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-provenance.mjs
scripts.mcp-res:validate:v0.2: node scripts/verify-mcp-res-v02.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-official-conformance.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-profiles.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-oauth.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-validator-safety.mjs && node scripts/generate-mcp-res-profile-registry.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-governance.mjs
scripts.mcp-res:field: node scripts/verify-mcp-res-protocol-field.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-oauth.mjs && node scripts/verify-mcp-res-operations.mjs
scripts.agent:validate: pnpm --filter @resilireplay/agent build && node scripts/build-plugin-runtime.mjs && node scripts/validate-agent-assets.mjs
scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm agent:validate && pnpm mcp:inspector:verify && pnpm field:verify && pnpm site:check && pnpm package:smoke && pnpm secret:scan && pnpm hygiene:scan && pnpm agent:gates
